sq.q: A company’s app needs to scale across regions. Why use distributed computing?
answer: Distributed computing lets parts of an application run on multiple systems across locations. It improves fault tolerance, scalability, and load distribution. This is ideal for cloud-based, high-traffic services.

sq.q: In which situation is a shared model insufficient?
answer: Shared memory is limited to a single system or tightly-coupled environments. It doesn't scale well across multiple machines or regions. In such cases, distributed memory with message passing is preferred.
